summary: Say nothing until you have something to say: {senior member} tells you on your first day not to speak on the floor until you have something to say.
realLife: One life: Picked by Tammany leader Tom Foley for the New York Assembly, the young Smith got one piece of advice: do not speak until you have something to say. He sat as a back-bencher learning who was who. Another: The advice to get along by going along is tied to him, though no record of him saying it to new members is known.
choices: follow it and learn the room
speak on your first bill anyway
ask what they want from you

branches.then: A member says the way to get along is to go along, and asks whether you will.
From high above the floor you learn who is who, a record of ties.
